theorems.name: Submission.pit_fderiv_lower_bound_of_density
theorems.statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (F : Euclid n → Euclid P) (B : Set (Euclid n)) (m : ℝ) (b : Euclid n), 0 < m → (∀ a ∈ B, m * ‖a - b‖ ≤ ‖F a - F b‖) → DifferentiableAt ℝ F b → Tendsto (fun ρ : ℝ => volume (B ∩ closedBall b ρ) / volume (closedBall b ρ)) (𝓝[>] 0) (𝓝 1) → ∀ c : Euclid n, m * ‖c‖ ≤ ‖fderiv ℝ F b c‖
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
